blocks.text: Wildlife photographer of the year 2026 winners – in pictures

A selection of the winning images from this year’s competition across topics ranging from underwater to urban wildlife, and photojournalism to mammal behaviour. The overall winner is Federico Veronesi of Italy for his powerful image of an elephant carrying a dead calf
The winning photographs will be showcased at the Natural History Museum in London from 16 October 2026 until July 2027

links.text: at the Natural History Museum in London

blocks.text: Wed 14 Oct 2026 08.41 BST

bagan , or mobile net-fishing platform, in the inky waters off Papua. He started searching for sharks around dawn when the nets were still in the water. Initially lacking natural light for his drone’s camera, he found these sharks illuminated by the

blocks.text: Secret Worlds by Kutub Uddin, Bangladesh/UK | Winner, Portfolio Award

Cribraria aurantiaca is at a tiny and often overlooked stage in its life. Uddin became interested in slime moulds in 2024, and devotes much of his time to revealing this hidden world – exploring his local woodlands in West Sussex, where fallen logs and damp forest floors provide opportunities for discovering these fascinating organismsPhotograph: Kutub Uddin/Wildlife photographer of the year 2026
